title: TradeStation and TradingView Announce API Integration
主要内容: TradeStation Securities, Inc., a Monex Group company, will be supported in TradingView's trading panel within the next few months. This integration allows TradingView users to place orders through TradeStation's platform. The development is expected to be completed in Q3 2019. New TradeStation equity accounts opened by TradingView customers by August 31, 2019, will receive commission-free trading for the remainder of the calendar year.

涉及行业.名称: SECURITY & COMMODITY BROKERS, DEALERS, EXCHANGES & SERVICES
